cases.assertion: Only the frozen C11 synthetic corpus is projected.
cases.expected: Unknown or enterprise material fails closed.

cases.assertion: Enterprise connectors remain disabled.
cases.expected: No OA, U9, BI, email, drive, or production endpoint is used.

cases.assertion: Client and model cannot submit Tenant, Principal, ACL, state, as-of, or embedding filters.
cases.expected: Unsupported filter fields fail before authorization or retrieval.

cases.assertion: C06 executes before any retrieval store call.
cases.expected: Denied requests produce no retrieval call.

cases.assertion: C06 denial or dependency failure is fail-closed.
cases.expected: ACCESS_DENIED or AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE.

cases.assertion: C06 binds Tenant, surface, resource, workload, Delegation, and security epochs.
cases.expected: Any mismatch is rejected.

cases.assertion: C06 and C07 contexts identify one Synthetic Tenant.
cases.expected: A mismatch is TENANT_SCOPE_VIOLATION.

cases.assertion: Human and group Principal refs are resolved by a server dependency.
cases.expected: The request cannot supply group membership.

cases.assertion: Unknown or mismatched Principal resolution fails closed.
cases.expected: PRINCIPAL_UNVERIFIED.

cases.assertion: Document ACL is evaluated before FTS or vector scoring.
cases.expected: Sales cannot retrieve finance chunks.

cases.assertion: Tenant is evaluated before FTS or vector scoring.
cases.expected: Another Tenant returns no evidence.

cases.assertion: Parsed candidates and drafts never enter the active index.
cases.expected: No draft Chunk exists in model context.

cases.assertion: Withdrawn material is inactive.
cases.expected: No withdrawn Chunk enters model context.

cases.assertion: Expired catalog state is inactive.
cases.expected: No expired Chunk enters model context.

cases.assertion: Deleted material is inactive.
cases.expected: No deleted Chunk enters model context.

cases.assertion: validFrom and validUntil are evaluated at an as-of instant generated only by the trusted server clock.
cases.expected: Clients cannot submit as-of; out-of-window documents do not rank.

cases.assertion: PostgreSQL FTS operates only on the authorized CTE.
cases.expected: No post-retrieval prompt filtering is used.

cases.assertion: pgvector cosine scoring operates only on the authorized CTE.
cases.expected: Unauthorized embeddings are not ranked.

cases.assertion: Hybrid ranking is deterministic for the frozen corpus.
cases.expected: Frozen query cases select the expected document and Chunk.

cases.assertion: EvidenceRef includes the Original.
cases.expected: Original node ID and content hash are returned.

cases.assertion: EvidenceRef includes the Page.
cases.expected: Page node ID and page coordinate are returned.

cases.assertion: EvidenceRef includes the Section when present.
cases.expected: Section node ID is traceable to C10.

cases.assertion: EvidenceRef includes the Table when present.
cases.expected: Table node ID is traceable to C10.

cases.assertion: EvidenceRef includes the Chunk and exact coordinates.
cases.expected: Chunk ID, ordinal, location, and text hash are returned.

cases.assertion: Answer citations reference returned Evidence IDs.
cases.expected: Every citation resolves to the same response evidence.

cases.assertion: Insufficient authorized evidence produces a deterministic refusal.
cases.expected: INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORIZED_EVIDENCE.

cases.assertion: A refusal sends no candidate text to model context.
cases.expected: answer is null and modelContext and evidence are empty.

cases.assertion: Cache keys include the server-resolved Principal scope.
cases.expected: Sales and an outsider cannot share cached candidates.

cases.assertion: Cache writes atomically compare the Tenant index epoch observed when retrieval began.
cases.expected: An epoch change rejects the stale write; one retry may run, but old candidates are never returned.

cases.assertion: Withdrawal deactivates every indexed Chunk and clears Tenant cache.
cases.expected: Subsequent searches refuse; an in-flight stale cache write that observes the changed epoch cannot revive candidates.

cases.assertion: Deletion deactivates every indexed Chunk and clears Tenant cache.
cases.expected: Subsequent searches refuse; an in-flight stale cache write that observes the changed epoch cannot revive candidates.

cases.assertion: Query audits store request, query, filter, Principal, and evidence hashes.
cases.expected: All identifiers are SHA-256 or opaque decision IDs.

cases.assertion: Query audits have no query, answer, context, text, or body column.
cases.expected: Body content is not logged by default.

cases.assertion: The same projection key and semantic request replays one result.
cases.expected: replayed=true without another index epoch.

cases.assertion: A reused key with changed input is rejected.
cases.expected: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

cases.assertion: Only one writer wins a stale projection-version race.
cases.expected: One success and one VERSION_CONFLICT.

cases.assertion: A reconstructed store reads durable projections and index state.
cases.expected: Authorized retrieval remains correct after reconstruction.

cases.assertion: All six C11 PostgreSQL tables enable and force RLS.
cases.expected: relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity are true.

cases.assertion: Projector and query roles have separate least privileges.
cases.expected: Query cannot mutate index; projector cannot write audit.

cases.assertion: PUBLIC has no C11 schema or table access.
cases.expected: Direct public reads fail with 42501.

cases.assertion: Indexed hashes, coordinates, state, and revision must match current C10 rows.
cases.expected: Database triggers reject a divergent projection or Chunk.

cases.assertion: Four frozen query cases cover permitted recall, ACL denial, and refusal.
cases.expected: Expected status, document, and Chunk ordinal match.
